## <b>Daniela Sporter, CRNP</b>

Hospice and Palliative Medicine

Daniela Sporter is a nurse
practitioner specializing in
palliative medicine and supportive
care.

She earned her Bachelor of Science
in nursing from the Ohio State
University in Columbus, Ohio, and
her Master of Science in nursing
and Doctor of Nursing Practice
from Robert Morris University in
Moon Township, Pennsylvania.

Daniela is board-certified by the
American Academy of Nurse
Practitioners. She sees adult
patients and speaks English.
